name: Perseverance
about: Perseverance (2020-052A, NASA/JPL), launched 2020 Jul 30. Its phases from GCAT: Mars, HCO, Jezero. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 1.009 au and aphelion 1.628 au against GCAT's 1.013 and 1.642
